reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: The invariant 'DataColumnSidecar.index == column_index' from 01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json (line 737) applies to construction-time in get_data_column_sidecars, not gossip validation. Code review confirms: (1) build_data_column_sidecars at kzg_utils.rs:278 sets index from enumerate position, enforcing the invariant at construction; (2) Gossip sidecars arrive individually, not as arrays—the 'index' field is an identifier (custody column ID), not an array position; (3) reconstruct_data_columns at kzg_utils.rs:372 explicitly sorts data_columns by index before processing, neutralizing any hypothetical position manipulation; (4) verify_is_unknown_sidecar (data_column_verification.rs:569) prevents duplicate indices via (slot, proposer, index) tuple tracking. The attack scenario 'swapped indices at different positions' is not applicable because gossip sidecars don't have positional semantics—they're keyed by index field. The spec invariant (SG-003 diagram line 25) confirms this is a construction invariant, not a validation requirement for received data. This is a spec-compliant design choice, not a vulnerability.
